(-ότερος), προφητικὸς λόγος, 2Pe.1:19.† (AS)

3798.full: γεννητός, -ή -όν (γεννάω), [in LXX: Job.11:2, 12 14:1 15:14 25:4 (ילד)* ;] begotten, born: pl., γ. γυναικῶν (cf. יְלוּד אִשָּׁה, Job.14:1), periphrasis for mankind, Mat.11:11, Luk.7:28 (Cremer, 147). (AS)

3799.full: 1. like αὐτόχθων, earthborn , of the primeval men, (Herdotus Historicus) 2. born of Gaia or Tellus , of the Titans and Giants, (Aeschulus Tragicus); so of things, portentous, furious , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)
